entities.summary: Albano Antonio Carrisi, better known as Al Bano, is an Italian singer and actor. Having sold over 25 million records globally and career spanning seven decades, he is one of the most recognisable Italian singers in the world. He has gained worldwide notability due to his four and a half octave vocal range as well as his personal and professional association with Romina Power, daughter of Hollywood actor Tyrone Power, lasting until the 1990s. Carrisi is acclaimed for singing with operatic affinity in pop, rock and italo disco repertoires with extensive head voice and minimal usage of falsetto vocal register.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As one of Italy's most successful and enduring pop stars, Al Bano Carrisi has had a lasting impact on Italian popular music, with numerous chart-topping hits and sold-out tours across the globe. His iconic collaborations and enduring legacy have cemented his status as an Italian music icon.
